sharedSource.pinnedQueue: wgpu 29.0.4 and wgpu-core 29.0.4: write_buffer allocates a new native staging buffer, PendingWrites consumes it into temp_resources, and the next submit owns it until completion. Destination buffer Arcs are also retained.

invariant: No per-frame queue staging before successful drawable acquisition. Timeout/Occluded skip; Outdated reconfigures; Lost recreates; Validation or failed recovery errors; none invoke frame uploads. Resize coalesces to one CPU projection. Acquired normal/suboptimal frames prepare and submit in the existing order.
scope: Deterministic real skip enum routing and callback order, successful recovery represented by a token, not a fabricated GPU measurement. Owned normal bounded rendering and memory observations on a corrected candidate remain separate; no claim that all memory growth or the OS crash is resolved.
